name: @jdg-keyforge/sdk
description: Node.js SDK for KeyForge plugins and clients: connect to the daemon, perform the hello handshake and dispatch plugin actions.
author: Jonathan Daniel Gomez <jonathan.d.gomez98@gmail.com>

scripts.clean: node -e "for (const d of ['dist', 'coverage']) require('fs').rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.lint:examples: for dir in ../examples/node/*/; do (cd "$dir" && eslint --config ../../../node/eslint.config.js . && prettier --config ../../../node/.prettierrc --ignore-path ../../../node/.prettierignore --check .) || exit 1; done
scripts.format:examples: for dir in ../examples/node/*/; do (cd "$dir" && prettier --config ../../../node/.prettierrc --ignore-path ../../../node/.prettierignore --write .) || exit 1; done
